identity.notes: Azure Palm Beaches (operating as the Azure Condo Association of Palm Beach Gardens) is a 100-unit residential condominium community at 2700 Donald Ross Rd, West Palm Beach / Palm Beach Gardens, FL 33410, Palm Beach County. The HOA (Federal ID 81-3264985) was established June 26, 2014. The community is gated and offers extensive amenities including a community pool, spa, sauna, clubhouse, fitness center, dock, and canal. Official site: https://azurepalmbeaches.com/. HOA fee amounts were not stated in the provided sources and remain unverified by residents.

fees.note: HOA fees are required (listed as 'HOA Required Plus Fees' on florida-condo-associations.com) but no amount is stated in the provided content. Per hoa-agent.com, this community's fee has not yet been verified by residents. The average monthly HOA fee for Palm Beach Gardens is approximately $641 (area average only, NOT specific to this community). No CDD/special assessment signals reported yet for this community. Verify directly with the association or its property manager. Utilities (FPL electric, Seacoast Utility Authority water/sewer, SWA Palm Beach County trash) are listed as services but are not HOA fee amounts as stated in the sources. (retrieved_at: 2025-01-01T00:00:00Z; confidence: 0.3)

open_questions: Official HOA/CDD fee amounts are not published anywhere found: state association directory fee field is blank and HOA-Agent reports the fee 'has not yet been verified by residents'. The only figure found is $3,997/month on active MLS listing B26084181 (unit 503) syndicated via Beaches MLS (raveis.com, movoto.com) - treat as listing-level and confirm via estoppel certificate (19 disclosures required under Fla. Stat. 718.116).
The $472/month figure on CommunityPay is explicitly a Palm Beach County area-median benchmark, not Azure's fee - do not use as the community's HOA dues.
No CDD special-assessment data found in any source; HOA-Agent reports 'no assessment signals' as of its Oct 2026 update.
Management company conflict: HOA-Agent says FirstService Residential; the Florida state directory lists FPMS, 5600 Granada Dr, Sarasota FL 34231 (941-960-5000).

Exact distances (miles) to the hospital, library, and schools could not be verified from any page read; the official site only states residents live 'less than two miles' from Juno Beach, The Gardens Mall, Abacoa Downtown, Donald Ross Plaza, and PGA Boulevard shopping - recorded as null distances for that reason.
Nearest grocery store not specifically identified (The Gardens Mall and Abacoa are the cited shopping areas within ~2 miles).
Which Palm Beach County library branch is actually closest to 2700 Donald Ross Rd is unverified; Gardens Branch is identified as the neighborhood library for the Palm Beach Gardens area.
